title: Basis of the Closing Folio Balance at a Hotel Departure
content:
The closing folio balance is the figure the guest settles when the folio of a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is closed off at departure.

**The settled charges.** The settled charges are the room nights, the statutory charges, the property facility fee, the parking, the occupancy supplement, the breakfast and the agency service fee standing on the folio, added together and rounded to the cent; the deposit already held is not one of them and is set against them instead. Before the closing folio balance is worked out, the statutory charge for the last night of the stay must stand on the folio.

**The balance.** The closing folio balance is the settled charges less the direct billed amount, less the deposit already held, less the goodwill reduction, less the service fee waiver, less the parking rebate and plus the departure service charge, rounded to the cent.

**The direct billed amount.** The direct billed base is the room nights alone, and the direct billed share is nil. The direct billed amount is the direct billed share of the direct billed base, rounded to the cent.

**The three reductions.** The goodwill reduction is nil. The service fee waiver is nil. The parking rebate is nil.

**The departure service charge.** The service charge rate is nil, and the departure service charge is the service charge rate of the breakfast standing on the folio, rounded to the cent. The closing folio balance is fixed only after the folio carries the breakfast owed for the departure morning.

*Worked through on hypothetical figures.* A folio carries 1320.00 USD of room nights, 200.00 USD of statutory charges, 175.00 USD of property facility fee, 140.00 USD of parking, 150.00 USD of occupancy supplement, 84.00 USD of breakfast and 14.95 USD of agency service fee, with a deposit of 264.00 USD already held. The settled charges are those seven added together, or 2083.95 USD, the deposit standing outside them. The direct billed base is the room nights alone, 1320.00 USD, and the direct billed share is nil, so the direct billed amount is 0.00 USD. The goodwill reduction, the service fee waiver and the parking rebate are each nil. The service charge rate is nil, so the departure service charge on the 84.00 USD of breakfast is 0.00 USD. The closing folio balance is 2083.95 USD less 0.00 USD less 264.00 USD, or 1819.95 USD, rounded to the cent.
